scoring_rule: For each target diagram (t 0.2 s, K 2, measured window force, same intervals() as final/compare.py): (1) model level error = interval-censored single-offset fit of the target's upper columns with the frozen model as base (thermal_law.offset_fit), 0 = perfect; primary comparison T1k_break / T1k_peak / T1mu vs S1_strict (|error| smaller wins; differences < 0.03 log = 'not distinguishable', the A1-A2/B_T2 rep-rep yardstick). (2) level in the established statistic (offset vs A1+A2 no-Z law, base_A) compared to frozen level_A and its 90 % PI. (3) speed and beta exponents: the target's free censored fit (free_fit) vs the frozen model exponents over the target's own design (design_exponents evaluated at the target's (v, beta) columns; the frozen numbers here use the donor design). High-force archives: the frozen Fmax_N grid is scored only where the measured upper boundary is bracketed (finite interval) between 4 and 12 N; columns right-censored at the ceiling count as hits if the prediction lies above the ceiling. Versioning: a target is scored against the latest freeze whose created_kst precedes the target's processing start in timeres/replicate.log; A3 (processing started 10:10:53) is scored against the first freeze written after 10:10:53 only if that freeze precedes the A3 'done' line; otherwise A3 is reported as NOT pre-registered.
